title: Grateful Dead Live at Strand Lyceum on 1972-05-26
lineage: MR(film crew feed) at 7 1/2 i.p.s.>R at 7 1/2 i.p.s (Don Wolfe, Maxell UD XL reel tape) > Apogee Mini Me(24/96)>Apogee Mini DAC(monitoring)>LYNX ONE soundcard>Wavelab 5.0(dithered  to 20/44) > CD > EAC > Wavelab > CDWave > FLAC
source: SBD > Master Reel (film crew feed) at 7 1/2 i.p.s.

ai_review.summary: A robust low‑end soundboard with a touch of top‑end hiss captures an electrifying 1972 Europe show highlighted by a monster Truckin > Other One > Dew jam sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a full, bottom‑heavy mix that many reviewers describe as hot and up‑front, despite a slight hiss on the high frequencies. Musically the concert is praised as one of the best from Europe ’72, with the Truckin → Other One → Dew → Other One → Sing Me Back Home stretch singled out for its soaring jams.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers consistently give 4‑5 stars, highlighting an outstanding performance and a generally excellent soundboard recording with only minor high‑frequency hiss.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Slight hiss at the top end, but full, robust low end; mix described as hot and upfront.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Jam‑heavy flow with seamless transitions, especially the extended Truckin > Other One > Dew sequence.
